identity: WAIVER OF OUR RIGHT TO RECOVER

record.clause_text: THIS FORM IS PART OF THE POLICY AND MUST BE READ WITH THE DECLARATIONS AND ENDORSEMENTS. THE RELINQUISHMENT OF RECOVERY RIGHTS APPLIES EXCLUSIVELY TO INJURIES ARISING OUT OF THE SPECIFIC PROJECT OR OPERATIONS DETAILED IN THE WRITTEN CONTRACT. THIS WAIVER DOES NOT EXTEND TO ANY OTHER THIRD PARTIES INVOLVED IN THE INCIDENT WHO ARE NOT EXPLICITLY SCHEDULED. THE APPLICATION OF THIS WAIVER DOES NOT REDUCE OR RESTRICT THE BENEFITS OWED TO THE INJURED WORKER UNDER THE STATUTORY FRAMEWORK. A SPECIFIC PREMIUM CHARGE IS ASSESSED FOR EACH SCHEDULED WAIVER, CALCULATED AS A PERCENTAGE OF THE MANUAL PREMIUM GENERATED BY THE ASSOCIATED OPERATIONS. THE ENTERPRISE MUST MAINTAIN COPIES OF THE WRITTEN CONTRACTS REQUIRING THE WAIVER AND PRESENT THEM DURING THE FINAL PREMIUM AUDIT. IF THE WRITTEN CONTRACT IS DEEMED INVALID OR WAS EXECUTED AFTER THE INJURY OCCURRED, WE RETAIN OUR FULL RIGHTS OF RECOVERY. THIS ENDORSEMENT DOES NOT WAIVE OUR RIGHT TO SEEK RECOVERY FOR PAYMENTS MADE DUE TO THE GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR INTENTIONAL MISCONDUCT OF THE SCHEDULED THIRD PARTY.
record.clause_title: WAIVER OF OUR RIGHT TO RECOVER
